purpose: Teach: ズーム/ベンツ/ルネッサンス/洋画/マンチェスター/ジャンボ/アドリブ/コナン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、カメラのズーム機能ばっか使ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were always just zooming in with the camera, weren't you?
lines.style: Dry observation with a slight edge. Quick, matter-of-fact delivery. A playful call-out that lands soft — teasing a friend she trusts.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ベンツに憧れてたな、桜
lines.en: You were the one drooling over Mercedes, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick comeback. A bit of mock-innocence — turning it back on her smoothly. Slight smirk in the voice without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でルネッサンス習ったろ?
lines.en: Wait — didn't you study the Renaissance in history class, Riku?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity mixed with amusement. Slight upturn at the question mark. She's testing whether he actually remembers — not mean, just checking.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、洋画よりアニメ派だったな、桜
lines.en: You always picked anime over Western movies, Sakura.
lines.style: Matched observation. Equally calm comeback. Eyes level — he's not backing down from the teasing, just keeping it balanced and light.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、マンチェスターのチーム応援してたな
lines.en: Didn't you used to support that Manchester team?
lines.style: Curious, slightly testing. Genuine interest but with an undertone of 'I caught you.' Conversational lilt on the question.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ジャンボサイズのフライドポテト食ってたな、桜
lines.en: And you were always ordering the jumbo fries, Sakura.
lines.style: Patient, warm observation. Matter-of-fact, with affection underneath. He's remembering something specific and small about her — not attacking, just noticing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、アドリブ得意なんだな
lines.en: So you're actually pretty good at improvising, huh?
lines.style: Genuine praise, without fuss. Straightforward and honest. Slight warmth — she means it. Not overdone, just real respect.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、コナン全巻持ってたろ?桜
lines.en: You had the entire Conan series, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Close, wondering tone. Intimate memory surfacing. Slight pause before her name — catching himself noticing something about her he shouldn't quite admit.
